item.title: Saudi Arabia Gold price today: Gold falls, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Gold prices fell in Saudi Arabia on Wednesday, according to data compiled by FXStreet.

item.title: US Dollar Index remains subdued near 98.50 amid risk-on mood, US data eyed
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, is edging lower after registering modest gains in the previous session and hovering around 98.50 during the Asian hours on Wednesday.

item.title: Australian Dollar reaches 15-month highs due to hawkish RBA outlook
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) rises against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, continuing its winning streak for the fourth successive session. The AUD/USD pair rises despite the easing of Australia's inflation in November.

item.title: Gold pulls back from $4,500 amid profit-taking ahead of key US macro data
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its strong weekly gains registered over the past two days and faces rejection near the $4,500 psychological mark, or over a one-week high touched during the Asian session on Wednesday.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Sees immediate support near $55 amid US-Venezuela clash
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI), futures on NYMEX, trade 1.15% lower to near $56.00 during the late Asian trading session on Wednesday.

item.title: GBP/JPY moves away from multi-year top, holds above 211.00 amid mixed cues
item.description: The GBP/JPY cross turns lower for the second straight day on Wednesday and moves away from its highest level since August 2008, around the 212.15 region, touched the previous day.

item.title: USD/CAD posts mild gains above 1.3800 as crude oil dips
item.description: The USD/CAD pair trades with mild gains near 1.3810 during the early European session on Wednesday. A fall in crude oil prices exerts some selling pressure on the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the Greenback.

item.title: USD/INR slumps after RBI's first intervention of 2026
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains sharply against the US Dollar (USD) on Wednesday, with the USD/INR pair slumping almost 0.5% to near 89.80.

item.title: EUR/CAD holds gains near 1.6150 ahead of Germany Retail Sales data
item.description: EUR/CAD extends its winning streak for the third consecutive day, trading around 1.6150 during the Asian hours on Wednesday. The currency cross gains ground ahead of Germany’s Retail Sales and Unemployment data for November due later in the day.

item.title: Japanese Yen advances vs. weaker USD amid divergent BoJ-Fed outlooks
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) adds to its modest Asian session gains against a broadly softer US Dollar (USD) and reverses a major part of the previous day's decline.
